answer: An agent may open only one lotus slot, and only by posting a non-transferable ember — a time-decaying bond that shrinks if proofs lapse. Validity is a pulse: the agent signs a secret nonce that three graph-distant established validators reveal only after the agent finishes a unique unpaid task they jointly assigned. Opening a second lotus with a reused key, or copying another agent's pulse, extinguishes every ember under that key. Payouts stay locked until seven consecutive clean pulses are recorded.
